Across the ten services, subscriptions billed through Amazon Prime Video Channels churn at an average of 8.7% a month against 5.8% a month for subscriptions billed direct, a gap of 2.9 points that holds on every title in the set.

Average monthly churn, Amazon Prime Video Channels path: 8.7%, Average monthly churn, direct path: 5.8%, Blended monthly churn, both paths: 6.7%.

- HBO Max: 21.3% share, 8.1% penetration. Amazon path 8.1% monthly, direct 5.2%
- Paramount+: 17.6% share, 9.4% penetration. Amazon path 9.4% monthly, direct 6.3%
- Peacock: 16.4% share, 9.7% penetration. Amazon path 9.7% monthly, direct 6.6%
- Apple TV: 12.7% share, 7.4% penetration. Amazon path 7.4% monthly, direct 4.8%
- STARZ: 9.8% share, 10.3% penetration. Amazon path 10.3% monthly, direct 7.1%
- AMC+: 6.3% share, 9.1% penetration. Amazon path 9.1% monthly, direct 6.2%
- MGM+: 5.1% share, 8.9% penetration. Amazon path 8.9% monthly, direct 6.4%
- BET+: 4.2% share, 8.3% penetration. Amazon path 8.3% monthly, direct 5.9%
- Acorn TV: 3.4% share, 6.8% penetration. Amazon path 6.8% monthly, direct 4.6%
- BritBox: 3.2% share, 6.4% penetration. Amazon path 6.4% monthly, direct 4.3%

Channels starts run 46.1% still active at day 60 (7,287,543 accounts) and 38.4% at day 90 (6,070,315); direct starts run 61.4% at day 60 (32,299,971) and 54.2% at day 90 (28,512,351). The Channels path skews promo-led and bundle-adjacent, and it reads as a shelf where a second cancel is one tap inside an account the person already keeps for other reasons.
- A cancel is dated to the cancel request, not to the day access ends. The request date is what sets the survival curve and the day 35 cut above; the paid-through tail runs a median 18 days past that date, so an access-end basis would lift every day 30 and day 90 figure by roughly half a billing cycle. Both paths are on the same request-date basis here, so the comparison is clean.
- Months kept is observed, not projected, for 71.4% of the cohort months inside the 12 month frame: those months have elapsed and are counted from account status. The remainder runs forward on each cohort's own measured curve from its current age, which is why the figures carry one decimal and no further.
- Where Channels carries the most weight is where retention reads thinnest. AMC+ takes 46.3% of its starts through Channels and STARZ 42.7%, both franchise and promo driven, and those services pull the blended Channels curve down; Apple TV at 21.4% Channels and the larger direct-first services hold the top of the band.

Why the full-window number sits above each period: A person is counted once for the whole window but only in the periods they were active, so each quarter or month can only equal or fall below the full-window share, and the periods do not add up to it. A brand whose audience spreads across the year reads higher for the year than for any one quarter.
